title: The Delta Where All Forgetting Meets Wide Water

features.name: the mouth that forgets to speak
features.desc-on-touch: The river widens and loses direction. Words arrive from upstream but dissolve into the salt water before they can reach anyone. This is where meaning becomes indistinguishable from weather.

features.name: the names that became tides
features.desc-on-touch: A filecard listing all the words the delta has dissolved this season. The list grows hourly. No name survives the passage into salt.

features.name: the islands forgetting what they held
features.desc-on-touch: Small forms rise from the water and sink again, each one a place where something specific used to be. The islands are eroding as fast as names disappear.

features.name: the estuary's archive
features.desc-on-touch: A wireframe structure that seems to hold the delta's shape, but the shape keeps changing. The archive here is as liquid as the water, its contents rearranging with each tide.

features.name: wide water's testimony
features.desc-on-touch: A glyph half-submerged, its meaning still legible if you squint, but fading into abstraction. The water is patient; it does not erase quickly.

inscription: here the confluence forgot how to keep anything — the river learns to let go
